answer: Locks are recorded in comet, expire in pulse, and marble lists each expiry. Someone running 178 aliases therefore needs 102 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1753 identities would post 4158 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
